purpose: Fog art for asset id art.fog.unexplored.v1 (Unexplored fog); drawn over cells in the 'unexplored' visibility state. This is a REDO: the delivered asset replaces the current file one-for-one at promotion.
prompt: Fog-of-war overlay tile: unexplored fog of war: an opaque near-black tile with fine light diagonal hatch lines. Uniform across the whole tile so adjacent fog tiles form a seamless field, crisp 1:1 pixels, no text.
negativePrompt: photograph, 3D render, isometric perspective, blur, anti-aliasing, smooth gradients, text, watermark, signature, border, frame

style.summary: Matches the repository's classic-board pixel art: 128 x 128 top-down tile, crisp 1:1 pixels, flat stepped shading with light from the top-left, shadows shifting toward blue-violet and lights toward yellow, the generated palette of eight hue ramps (stone, wood, earth, moss, cloth-warm, cloth-cool, metal, skin) plus cool-grey neutrals.
style.palette: Generated ramp palette, see src/assets/palette.ts; keep to the same hue families as the current asset.

background.notes: Fully opaque near-black; no drop shadow.

acceptanceCriteria: File is a PNG, exactly 128 x 128, 8-bit RGBA.
Composition, footprint and transparency class match the current fog-unexplored-v1.png so the file is a drop-in replacement (same name at promotion).
Pixels are crisp: no anti-aliased edges, no smooth gradients; a 4x nearest-neighbour zoom shows only hard-edged pixels.
No text, signature, watermark, border or frame.
Seamless with itself on all four edges.
Opacity ordering preserved: unexplored darker than hidden, hidden darker than revealed (compare the three current fog tiles).
notes: Part of batch redo-starter-art-v1: a redo of every starter art asset. Recipe from src/assets/starter-art-inputs.ts: {"kind": "fog", "material": "fog", "state": "unexplored"}.
